subject: jade-everrest
label: Jade is five foot nine
note:
FIVE INCHES, AND THE ARCHIVE HAD IT WRONG THE WHOLE TIME. Her v5 and v7 profiles both read 6'2", and Viraena struck it down directly on 7 September: Jade is 5'9".

THIS MATTERS MORE THAN A NUMBER. At 6'2" Jade stood eye-to-eye with her wife. At 5'9" Pandora — 6'1" — has FOUR INCHES on her, and every recorded posture between them reads differently for it: the tall frame LOWERING ITSELF toward her wife's hands is a shorter woman looking up, and the Shrine settling half a beat behind the captain is settling on a smaller frame.

The profiles are older than the truth. The truth is 5'9".
